package.name: g1_nav
package.description: Navigation FSM orchestrator for the Unitree G1: accepts a NavigateTo action goal, coordinates g1_costmap / g1_global_planner / g1_local_planner, gates /cmd_vel, runs recovery, and reports progress. Thin coordinator over already-separate ROS nodes; does not re-implement planning or tracking. ROS-free core (g1_nav_core: FSM + recovery sequencer + progress watchdog) + thin ROS node.
package.author: Rohan
